row.evidence: ProGet's edition matrix lists AD/LDAP security (Basic and Enterprise) and SAML Authentication (Enterprise only) but no SCIM, and SCIM appears nowhere in the pricing page, the full docs source, the Security API reference or the knowledge base.
row.notes: Status changed from unknown to none (by absence, medium confidence). Self-hosted, licensed per server per year with unlimited users, so per-user prices are null. Pricing changed since June: the June row treated the Free edition as the team plan; the paid tiers are now Basic $2,395/yr, Enterprise Essentials $11,995/yr and Enterprise Complete from $29,995/yr. SAML SSO is Enterprise-only; AD/LDAP user directories from Basic. A Security HTTP API (Basic and up; restricted on Free) can create, edit, delete and list users and groups with a System or Personal API key, but no IdP catalogue app uses it for provisioning.

citations.title: Security API
citations.quote: The Security API provides several pgutil commands (available as pgutil security ) and HTTP endpoints to create, add, delete, and perform other operations on Users, Groups, Tasks and Permissions.

citations.title: Security API
citations.quote: To specify an API Key, use the request header ( X-ApiKey ), querystring ( key ), or api:«api-key» as the username.

citations.title: Security API
citations.quote: Note that Feed API keys cannot be used to authenticate to this API.

citations.title: Create User
citations.quote: Create User is available as both a pgutil command and an HTTP Request, and will create a new User account in ProGet.

citations.title: Create User
citations.quote: POST /api/security/users/add

citations.title: Edit User
citations.quote: POST /api/security/users/update

citations.title: Delete User
citations.quote: Delete User is available as both a pgutil command and an HTTP Request, and will delete a specified User account from ProGet.

citations.title: List Users
citations.quote: GET /api/security/users/list

citations.title: Create Group
citations.quote: POST /api/security/groups/add

citations.title: Delete Group
citations.quote: Delete Group is available as both a pgutil command and an HTTP Request, and will delete a specified Group from ProGet.

citations.title: List Groups
citations.quote: GET /api/security/groups/list

citations.title: Add Permission
citations.quote: POST /api/security/permissions/add

citations.title: Security API
citations.quote: Add Group Member - Adds a user to a Group* Remove Group Member - Removes a user from a Group* List Group Members - Lists members of a Group* * Only available as a pgutil command.
